```{r}
library(rvest)
library(httr)
```


## Import NSDUH

```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html = 
  read_html(url)
```


Pull the tables out

```{r}
marj_df = 
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |> 
  slice(-1)
```



## import some SW data

pull in the html

```{r}
swm_html = 
  read_html_live("https://www.imdb.com/list/ls070150896/")
```

Next up ... selector gadget

```{r}
swm_title_vec = 
  swm_html |> 
  html_elements(".ipc-title-link-wrapper .ipc-title__text") |> 
  html_text()

swm_metascore_vec = 
  swm_html |> 
  html_elements(".metacritic-score-box") |> 
  html_text()

swm_runtime_vec = 
  swm_html |> 
  html_elements(".base .ipc-inline-list__item:nth-child(2)") |> 
  html_text()

swm_df = 
  tibble(
    title = swm_title_vec,
    score = swm_metascore_vec,
    runtime = swm_runtime_vec
  )
  
```


## Use APIs

getting a csv

```{r}
nyc_water_df = 
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.csv") |> 
  content("parsed") |> 
  select(year:per_capita_gallons_per_person_per_day)
```

get a json file

```{r}
nyc_water_json = 
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.json")

nyc_water_json |> 
  content("text") |> 
  jsonlite::fromJSON() |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(year:per_capita_gallons_per_person_per_day) 
```

Look at some pokemon!

```{r}
pokemon_json = 
  GET("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/1")


pokemon_data = 
  pokemon_json |> 
  content()

pokemon_data[["name"]]
pokemon_data[["height"]]
pokemon_data[["abilities"]]
```
